review_notes: The file has one theorem, `bundleMapClass_comp_left`, and its proof is two steps: `rw [bundleMapClass, HomSpace.comp_ofFragment]`, then `exact HomSpace.ofFragment_congr f (bundleMapCompose e X)`. It already delegates the real work to the existing `bundleMapCompose`. I grepped for other uses of `bundleMapCompose` and `bundleMapClass` in the library. The hits were in `MonoidalStruct.lean`, where `bundleMapClass_comp` and `bundleMapClass_refl` are used for the isomorphism proofs, plus one use of `bundleMapCompose` in `MonoidalNat.lean`. I did not read these bodies in full. Their `rw [bundleMapClass_comp, ...]; exact bundleMapClass_refl` patterns are short and routine. I found no substantial argument repeated in more than one place, so extracting a shared helper would only relocate repetition. I am slightly uncertain because I did not read every related file.
